articles.title: Teen arrested for allegedly shooting man in Oshawa
articles.summary: A 17-year-old boy has been arrested for allegedly shooting a man in Oshawa last month. Durham police say the incident happened on June 14 around 3 p.m. in the area of Ritson Road North and Pentland Street. A 20-year-old man was found on the scene suffering from a gunshot wound. articles.title: Parrish and Crombie clash online over Mississauga data centre vote
articles.summary: Mississauga Mayor Carolyn Parrish and former mayor Bonnie Crombie engaged in a heated back‑and‑forth on X Thursday night, sparring over Parrish’s decision not to vote on the city’s controversial pause on new data‑centre applications. The exchange unfolded hours after council voted to temporarily halt new data‑centre proposals, giving staff time to study the strain large‑scale […]

articles.title: Woman shot in Scarborough parking lot, police say
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating an overnight shooting in Scarborough after a woman was found injured in a parking lot. Officers were called to the Morningside Avenue and Sheppard Avenue East area around 3:12 a.m. Friday following reports of gunfire. When they arrived, police located an adult female victim who had been shot. She was transported […]

articles.title: Trial of man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter to wrap its second week
articles.summary: ELIZABETHTOWN — The last testimonies of the week are scheduled today in the trial of a man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter last summer during a trip to New York.

articles.title: Man charged with 1st-degree murder in 2006 Scarborough cold case
articles.summary: Toronto police say they've arrested and charged a Hamilton man with first-degree murder in a Scarborough cold case dating back two decades, thanks to modern day forensic technology.

articles.title: Police watchdog investigating after man's fatal fall from Mississauga condo
articles.summary: The province's Special Investigations Unit says it's investigating the death of a 35-year-old man after he died in a fall from a Mississauga condo unit.

articles.title: Ontario announces funding for new medical school to train family doctors
articles.summary: Colleges and Universities Minister Nolan Quinn says the province is providing $55.8 million for York University's new school of medicine. He says the funds will help the school hire faculty, build a medical library and operate its undergraduate and graduate programs.

articles.title: 1 dead after crash between e-scooter, motor vehicle near Tommy Thompson Park: police
articles.summary: The rider of an e-scooter died in hospital after a collision near Toronto's waterfront Wednesday evening, police say.

articles.title: Toronto residents push for moratorium on data centres in city, raise concerns over environmental impact
articles.summary: Some Toronto residents are demanding a one-year moratorium on two proposed data centre projects in the city's Etobicoke and Scarborough areas.

articles.title: Toronto council demands Ford government return land province took for rejected Billy Bishop Airport expansion
articles.summary: This spring, the province passed a law allowing it to take over municipal land for its planned expansion of Billy Bishop Airport. On Wednesday, days after the federal government rejected the province's proposal for the island airport, Toronto city council voted to demand the Ford government give it back.
